title: Every doctor check (ship-fleet doctor [--offline] --json, version 1)
description: Printed by `ship-fleet doctor [--offline] --json` on the FleetLedger computer: the checks the text form prints, in its order, each with its state and the command that fixes it. Read-only: it changes nothing; --offline skips the Proxmox API. It answers while the vault is locked, on a copy on standby or retired, as the text form does, and exits as it does: 1 when any check is missing or fail, else 0. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

key.description: Which check it is (contracts/ship-fleet.md lists them). With subject, it names the item: a check made once per machine or Ship appears once for each.

subject.description: fleet.machine-certificate, fleet.machine-refresh-refused, fleet.machine-refresh-stopped: the trusted machine's name; ships.not-enrolled: the Ship's; fleet.managed-keys, when it fails: the key file's path, as FleetLedger records it (one item per key). null otherwise.

title.description: The check's name as the text form's CHECK column shows it.

state.description: ok; info (fine, with a next step); warn; missing; fail; skip (not checked, or not set up and optional). missing and fail make the command exit 1.

fix.description: The exact command (or step) that fixes it; empty when there is none. The text form's Next list shows it for info, warn, missing and fail.
